verdict.rationale: Docs and a runtime probe show granular install of individual skills (e.g. `/plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills` vs a full marketplace, and a real `npx skills add ... --skill skill-creator` install of just one skill from the repo) rather than being forced to take the whole bundle. missing for 10: no first-party UI walkthrough showing selection among multiple skills within a single plugin package, and no broader independent corroboration beyond one probe run.
